learnerStatement: Simulated learner. This review finds problems; it is not evidence that anyone learned.
learnerBoundary: Everyday numeracy, simple charts, comparison of numbers and familiar household objects; no domain-specific theory assumed.

observations.prediction: Selected 4 against 6 and 12 for the nine-day consecutive-run total; locked it in.
observations.exploration: Next day showed day 1 total −2, best −2. Start over cleared total to 0 while best remained −2. Enabled Auto start over below 0. Play to day 9 ended total 5, best 6 on days 4–7, compared with kept-everything best 2. Check all 45 stretches confirmed largest total 6 and unlocked reveal.
observations.reveal: Corrected to 6 and named actual drops −2 after days 1 and 3. Explained negative prefix drags down following stretch and compared one pass over nine days with all 45 stretches; named Kadane algorithm.
observations.visual: Actual 1257 × 936 dark screenshot inspected. Triangular table of all stretch sums highlights 6, live status and reveal readable. Internal stage scrolled so upper line chart partly cropped in reveal view.
